caseName: Kartell v. Blue Shield of Massachusetts, Inc.
caseNameFull: Kartell v. Blue Shield of Massachusetts, Inc. and Rodkey v. Blue Shield of Massachusetts, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 1st Cir. Motion of American Medical Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Ball Memorial Hospital, Inc., et al. for leave to file a brief as *1030amici curiae in No. 84-1353 granted. Certiorari denied. Reported below: 749 F. 2d 922.
